English: Prayer Alcove
A humble, makeshift shelter for Christian prayer, marked by a simple cross and offering a quiet corner for spiritual reflection among the nomads.
Stone Shrine
A sturdier place of worship constructed from gathered stones, providing a communal focus for Christian devotion and gatherings.
Basilica Chamber
A wooden-walled tent with icons and relics, modeled after the basilicas of the west, capable of holding larger congregations and fostering greater unity.
Worship Hall
A substantial, tented hall adorned with Christian banners, allowing for organized worship, rites, and the fostering of unity among the faithful.
Saints Niche
A dedicated alcove for icons or relics of saints, increasing the prestige of the clan and deepening communal reverence.
Apsidal Chapel
A semi-permanent wooden chapel with a rounded apse, boasting more elaborate Christian iconography and fostering strong clan unity.
Canopied Altar
A grand altar set beneath a decorated canopy, with relics and lamps, serving as a spiritual heart for the nomadic faithful.
Bishops Sanctuary
A well-established and lavish tented sanctuary, hosting a bishop or learned priest, providing guidance and spiritual authority for the entire clan.
Holy Reliquary Room
A secure, ornate chamber for housing relics and holy artifacts, drawing pilgrims and cementing the clans spiritual reputation.
Grand Christian Chapel
A majestic, semi-permanent chapel built of timber and stone, richly decorated and renowned among the steppes, serving as the spiritual heart of the nomadic Christian realm.
